notes.title: 5 Stand Stations Added, Index and Windows MR Support Added.
notes.content: In this update I focused on bringing a new game to the STRAIGHT ON 8 field. Welcome to the game of 5 Stand. Each station has a unique menu for Singles, Report and True Pair. Along with this addition I focused on fixing bugs with the hand swapping system, added a display in Tournament mode that tells you what the upcoming bird is going to be, increased the shot radius for slightly easier target hits and added in controller support for the Index and the Windows Mixed Reality headsets. I have also added a discord channel if you wanted to help with feedback. Follow the Twitter page for the discord link.

notes.title: Targets on Toggle Button now.
notes.content:
For better support across different types of motions controllers, I have transferred the  targets types (high, low and doubles) to a toggle system. To select the target type to throw toggle it with the                     
(L) FaceButton1 button. To throw the selected target used the (L) FaceButton2 button. There is also a indicator in the HUD that shows what target is currently selected. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37018884/7bbbf6e0992557ab610ba0292e981cb71b8cdc3b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Key Bindings Fix and Oculus Support
notes.content: The key binding bug with the Index has been fixed and the game now supports Oculus products.

notes.title: Art Update
notes.content:
